description: PERMANENTLY REMOVES a contact from a list — this MODIFIES live data and cannot be undone. `contact_id` is the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the id from list_contacts. EmailOctopus: DELETE /lists/{list_id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

contact_id.description: The contact's id to delete — the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the id from list_contacts.

name: emailoctopus_delete_contact
title: Delete contact
